svg.title: tantivy-turbo benchmark overview
svg.desc: TOP-10 results from October 30 over 1,201 queries; Lucene comparison from October 30 over 20 queries. TOP-10 vs Tantivy: 1.8×; TOP-10 vs lucene-rs: 1.25×; TOP-10 vs Lucene: 1.96–1.98×; correctness cases: 1,227
